mapper.sql: SELECT 'purchase' AS stat_type, h.id AS order_id, h.biz_date, h.warehouse_id, h.supplier_id AS partner_id, h.supplier_id, NULL AS customer_id, i.product_id, COALESCE(i.base_qty,i.qty) AS qty, i.amount, s.supplier_code AS partner_code, s.supplier_name AS partner_name FROM biz_purchase_in h JOIN biz_purchase_in_item i ON i.purchase_in_id=h.id LEFT JOIN base_supplier s ON s.id=h.supplier_id WHERE h.deleted=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'sale', h.id, CAST(h.completed_time AS DATE), h.warehouse_id, h.customer_id, NULL, h.customer_id, i.product_id, COALESCE(i.base_qty,i.qty), i.amount, COALESCE(c.customer_code,'GUEST'), CASE WHEN h.customer_id IS NULL THEN '散客' ELSE h.customer_name_snapshot END FROM biz_sale_out h JOIN biz_sale_out_item i ON i.sale_out_id=h.id LEFT JOIN base_customer c ON c.id=h.customer_id WHERE h.deleted=0 AND h.order_status='completed' AND h.completed_time IS NOT NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT AS dimension_id,
MAX(f.partner_code) AS dimension_code, MAX(f.partner_name) AS dimension_name, '' AS dimension_code, MAX(COALESCE(c.category_name,'未分类')) AS dimension_name, AS dimension_code, AS dimension_name, MAX(p.product_code) AS dimension_code, MAX(p.product_name) AS dimension_name,
CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)=1 THEN MAX(c.category_name) ELSE '' END AS category_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)=1 THEN MAX(p.spec) ELSE '' END AS spec, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT u.id)=1 THEN MAX(u.unit_name) ELSE '多种基础单位' END AS unit_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.stat_type='purchase' THEN f.partner_name ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR '、') AS supplier_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.stat_type='purchase' THEN f.partner_code ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR ',') AS supplier_code, SUM(f.amount) AS amount, SUM(f.qty) AS qty, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(f.stat_type,':',CONCAT('',f.order_id))) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN f.stat_type='purchase' THEN f.amount ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN f.stat_type='sale' THEN f.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sale_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN f.stat_type='purchase' THEN f.qty ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN f.stat_type='sale' THEN f.qty ELSE 0 END) AS sale_qty FROM () f JOIN base_product p ON p.id=f.product_id LEFT JOIN base_product_category c ON c.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN base_unit u ON u.id=p.base_unit_id WHERE 1=1 AND f.stat_type=#{source} AND f.warehouse_id=#{q.warehouseId} AND f.customer_id=#{q.customerId} AND f.supplier_id=#{q.supplierId} AND f.biz_date >=#{q.dateFrom} AND f.biz_date <=#{q.dateTo}
GROUP BY ORDER BY amount DESC, dimension_id

SELECT AS dimension_id,
MAX(w.warehouse_code) AS dimension_code, MAX(w.warehouse_name) AS dimension_name, '' AS dimension_code, MAX(COALESCE(c.category_name,'未分类')) AS dimension_name, MAX(p.product_code) AS dimension_code, MAX(p.product_name) AS dimension_name,
MAX(w.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)=1 THEN MAX(c.category_name) ELSE '' END AS category_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT u.id)=1 THEN MAX(u.unit_name) ELSE '多种基础单位' END AS unit_name, SUM(s.total_qty) AS qty, SUM(s.available_qty) AS available_qty, SUM(s.locked_qty) AS locked_qty, SUM(COALESCE(b.value_amount,0)) AS amount FROM inv_stock s JOIN base_product p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN sys_warehouse w ON w.id=s.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN base_product_category c ON c.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN base_unit u ON u.id=p.base_unit_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(remain_qty*unit_price) AS value_amount FROM inv_batch WHERE deleted=0 GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id) b ON b.warehouse_id=s.warehouse_id AND b.product_id=s.product_id WHERE s.deleted=0 AND s.warehouse_id=#{q.warehouseId}
GROUP BY ORDER BY amount DESC, dimension_id
